./docs/architecture/audio-playback-spectrum.md:25:  - Load audio files (`load(String path)`). All formats — including **Opus** — take the same path: `SoLoudTransport` tries native `loadFile(path)` first and falls back to decoding from a MediaStore `content://` URI (`readAndroidAudioBytes` → `loadMem`) only when raw-path access fails (Android 11+ scoped storage blocks raw `File`/native access to shared storage). ./docs/architecture/audio-playback-spectrum.md:26:  - **Opus decodes natively in `loadFile`/`loadMem`** (i.e. on `flutter_soloud`'s background `compute` isolate, like mp3) — *not* via a Dart-side `setBufferStream` + chunked `addAudioDataStream` feed on the UI isolate, which used to block frames for ~1–2 s on a multi-MB track. Stock `flutter_soloud` rejects Opus in `loadFile` (its Wav loader routes `OggS`→stb_vorbis), so this relies on a **local vendored fork** (`./soloud` via `dependency_overrides`) that wires the bundled Opus decoder into the file-load path. See `B-051` and `soloud/src/player.cpp` (`tryLoadOpusBufferStream`).
./docs/architecture/overview.md:49:    -   **`SoLoudTransport`** (macOS + Android): Thin wrapper around `flutter_soloud` (4.x) for playback and FFT. Single transport across platforms. Android packaging targets only `arm64-v8a` (no `armeabi-v7a`/`x86_64`). Built against a **local vendored fork** of `flutter_soloud` (`./soloud` via `dependency_overrides`) that adds native Opus decoding to `loadFile`/`loadMem` so Opus decodes off the UI isolate like mp3 (see `B-051`); revert to the pub.dev package once upstreamed.
./docs/backlog_done.md:1464:## B-051 (major): Opus load blocks the UI isolate (~1–2 s) — decode it natively in loadFile
./docs/backlog_done.md:1466:- **Symptom** — Loading an `.opus` track (the user's primary format, ~4–6 MB) stalls the UI isolate for ~1–2 s; the rest of the app plays gaplessly via `loadFile` (mp3/wav/flac) without this hitch.
./docs/backlog_done.md:1467:- **Repro** — Instrumented `_openOpusFromBytes` on the API 37 emulator (2026-06-01): the Dart-side `setBufferStream` + chunked `addAudioDataStream` feed ran on the **UI isolate**, and **78–86% of the ~300 ms/MB feed was synchronous native Opus decode inside the FFI call** (~32 ms per 128 KB chunk). The acquisition/fd angle (prior "Option A") was a measured **no-op** — with `READ_MEDIA_AUDIO` granted, raw reads succeed (`mode=direct-file`), so the cost was never I/O; it was decode-on-the-wrong-thread. Root cause: stock `flutter_soloud` `loadFile`/`loadMem` route `OggS`→stb_vorbis (Vorbis only) and reject Opus, forcing the buffer-stream workaround; the bundled Opus decoder (raw libopus+libogg) was wired only to the streaming path.
./docs/backlog_done.md:1468:- **Desired** — Opus decodes on the background `compute` isolate like mp3, so the UI never blocks on it.
./docs/backlog_done.md:1469:- **Notes** — Fixed via a **local vendored fork** of `flutter_soloud` (`./soloud`, `dependency_overrides`; originally sourced from `maxim-saplin/flutter_soloud@opus-loadfile`).
